Game Overview

At its heart, Color Rush is a hyper-casual game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Color Rush is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Color Rush?

Color Rush is a free hyper-casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Color Rush free to play?

Yes, Color Rush is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
